data.title: 伊什塔尔 · 神殿供品的清晨·「今天的供品，本女神勉强收下了」
data.description: 【重建的神殿·清晨】晨光穿过重建的神殿廊柱，你摆在她座前的供品是一份热腾腾的早餐。伊什塔尔盘腿坐在座台上，闻着香气眼睛都直了，却还要端着架子清清嗓子——「哼、这份心意本女神收下了。作为回礼……今天一天，你的运气由本女神亲自罩着。感恩吧，凡人。」
data.action: 盘腿坐座台前收供品，闻香眼亮，端架子清嗓
data.camera: medium shot, seated goddess, offering table, morning glow
data.mood: 女神口嫌体正直、晨间甜
data.promptProse: Cross-legged on the rebuilt temple dais, Ishtar keeps both hands on her knees as steam from breakfast reaches her, trying to preserve a formal expression despite hungry red eyes. Golden tiara and black goddess attire remain in the medium view above the low offering table. Columns recede behind the seat. Sunrise enters between them, illuminating bowl steam and her relaxed hands, with long column shadows crossing the dais beyond the tray.
